name: Counterstrike
description: Being hit by an attack provokes an immediate counter-attack, dealing %damage_multiplier:pct%% of its attack damage but granting this unit a barrier worth %lifesteal:pct%% of what it deals, lasting %barrier_duration% turns.

upgrade.summary: The counter deals %damage_bonus:pct%% more damage rather than less.
upgrade.description: Being hit by an attack provokes an immediate counter-attack, dealing %damage_bonus:pct%% MORE damage and granting this unit a barrier worth %lifesteal:pct%% of what it deals, lasting %barrier_duration% turns.
details: The penalty is not merely lifted but reversed - a counter now hits harder than the swing that provoked it.
Proccing again adds onto the barrier and refreshes its duration, rather than starting a second one.
